metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value: Noble Pokémon of wing and claw fly high in the Pokémon TCG: Dragon Majesty expansion! Look for Dragon Majesty collections to bring forth a mighty horde of draconic Pokémon: Reshiram-GX, Salamence-GX, Dragonite-GX, and over a dozen more, including Charizard! Their command of fire, battle, and sky will rise to the top for collectors and competitors alike. Get ready to soar with these awesome Pokémon in the special Dragon Majesty expansion!

This Super-Premium Collection contains the following:

• 1 Rare Rainbow Foil promo card featuring Kingdra-GX (SM155)

• 1 Rare Rainbow Foil promo card featuring Dragonite-GX (SM156)

• 1 awesome figure of Dragonite

• 10 Dragon Majesty booster packs

• 3 collector’s boxes to store your cards

• 1 playmat for tournaments or for your desk

• 1 Dragons Then & Now booklet

• A code card for the Pokemon TCG Online

metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value: Harness the awesome powers of fire, lightning, and ice with this huge collection featuring a trio of Legendary Pokémon from the Unova region! The blazing Reshiram GX and the electrifying Zekrom GX are here as playable foil promo cards, and they unite with the freezing Kyurem on an amazing oversize card that pushes the boundaries of draconic power!

metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
After absorbing a Legendary Pokémon, Ultra Necrozma-GX has emerged as a mysterious Pokémon with strong psychic powers! Now this amazing Legendary Pokémon is ready to join your team, both as a playable Pokémon-GX and as a detailed, sculpted figure! This Pokémon adds a touch of danger and the unknown to your collection!

Each collection comes with:

• 4 Dragon Majesty booster packs

• 1 sculpted figure of Ultra Necrozma

• 1 holofoil promo of Ultra Necrozma GX

• 1 code card for the Pokemon Trading Card Game Online
